what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: A brief for the Web Summit team
sections.para: Seven of us go to Web Summit; the three teams stood up this week give the template; an event site consolidates the graph, the events, the materials and a countdown, around a map of companies, with email agents that sign and a separate design brief.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Seven lines from the team to the design
sections.para: Seven people; an event site run by agents; a proven template; roles, policies, keys and slots; the company map; email agents with keys; and a design brief.

sections.label: What changed since the plan
sections.para: Seven going, not five; and three agent teams stood up in hours this week, which with the PHP newsroom and RiskMandate's email workflow make a template.

sections.label: The site
sections.para: An event site for our participation, live at web-summit.sgit.ai since 28 October with six vaults: the graph of companies, people, sessions and products with sources; the events and materials; the day's synchronisation; a countdown and observability.

sections.label: The template
sections.para: A repository, brief and reality file; a role and policy per member; a key per session; hourly slots; the five-step wake; a hold; a board and mailroom in git; a gate with CI owning the version; and a done-when list.

sections.label: The roles
sections.para: Conductor, researcher, cartographer, writer, curator, analyst, designer and security, each owned by one of the seven, and an email agent per person.

sections.label: The company map
sections.para: For each company: what it does from public sources, why it matters, the decision to meet, interview or write, an owner and status, and the assets made; nothing private on the site.

sections.label: Email, and a key for each email agent
sections.line: Email, and a key for each email agent
sections.para: Email stays in each person's account with their own agent, not a shared vault; giving each agent a key vouched for by its person lets every email be verified, the next brief.

sections.label: Design
sections.para: T-shirts, hoodies, a banner, cards and flyers for seven people, with a designer and a design member, in their own brief.

sections.label: The schedule
sections.para: Up from the template by 2 November; the map, assets, meetings and print by 8 November; Lisbon 9 to 12; follow-up the week after, then pause.

sections.label: What I need to decide
sections.para: Who owns which agent, the design budget and designer, and which email accounts join first.

sections.label: Corrected
sections.para: The first version said none of the site existed and its address was unsettled; web-summit.sgit.ai had been live since 28 October, and the correction is logged.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.para: A brief: the site and its vaults exist, but what it describes is still to build; the map is public material; the schedule is a plan.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.para: My memo, the plan of 26 October, and the three teams' repositories.
